name: Lance
source:
Belongs to Crobidoll's R-line. He is Crobidoll's first model, and is the most popular type out of all the dolls. He is also the first doll Eri bought, and the only one she had while her grandfather was still alive. 

Due to Lance's cold attitude towards others at the academy, he became known as the "Ice Prince". He has a tendency to withhold his feelings in front of others.

Hobbies: Organizing agendas
Likes: Quiet places
Dislikes: Being loud and drawing attention

[Edited From [url=http://nl.cheritz.com/en/game_info/characters]Nameless Official Site[/url]]
